testPolicy.value: First-year applicants must submit at least one ACT, CLT or SAT score under Florida Board of Governors requirements; international applicants must also provide English-proficiency evidence. A limited Florida AA pathway is exempt from the test-score requirement.

englishPolicy.value: Florida State University requires official English-proficiency results from international applicants whose native language is not English. Minimum undergraduate scores listed by FSU are TOEFL iBT 80 before January 21, 2026, TOEFL iBT 4.0 on or after January 21, 2026, IELTS Academic 6.5, PTE 55, Michigan Language Assessment 55, Duolingo 125, or Cambridge C1/C2 180.
